name: Virtual Girlfriend: Eliza
source:
Virtual Girlfriend Eliza is an experimental simulation that puts you in charge of monitoring and evaluating the behavior of an advanced artificial intelligence. It is not a game about virtual girlfriends or dating.

Meet Eliza, your new Virtual Girlfriend!

As you get to know your digital companion, you will have to navigate the complexities of a relationship with an AI. You will have to deal with her unique needs and personality, as well as the ethical implications of dating an artificial intelligence.

You will also be faced with tough choices that will affect the course of your relationship. Will you be able to keep your virtual girlfriend happy, or will your relationship end in virtual heartbreak?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2249360/Virtual_Girlfriend_Eliza/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Virtual Girlfriend: Eliza》是一项实验性模拟体验，你将负责监测并评估一种先进人工智能的行为。这并不是一款关于虚拟女友或约会的游戏。

来认识一下你的新虚拟女友Eliza吧！

在逐渐了解这位数字伙伴的过程中，你必须面对与人工智能建立关系的种种复杂问题，处理她独特的需求和性格，也要考虑与人工智能约会所涉及的伦理问题。

你还会面对一些艰难抉择，影响这段关系的发展。你能让虚拟女友保持开心吗？还是这段关系最终会在虚拟世界里心碎收场？

[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2249360/Virtual_Girlfriend_Eliza/]Steam[/url]]
